says: In today's CI, the P8 law waits for the child journal's acknowledgement under a fixed 30-second bound, which decision 0609 rules out: a law waits on the event, and only the test runner's own limit backstops a part that never answers.
proof: .github/ci/progress-reporter.integration.test.ts:309 reads `observation.pipe(Effect.timeoutOption("30 seconds"), Effect.map(Option.getOrNull))`; .decisions/0609-laws-wait-on-events-never-on-a-fixed-time-bound.md's binding constraint says 'No law wraps a real build or other machine-speed work in a fixed time bound.' PR 1624 (da86605) added the bound on 2026-11-18, the date 0609 was accepted.
cost: The law keeps a shape an accepted decision forbids, so the next fix to it must first settle whether 0036's 'no timeout grows' or 0609's 'remove the clock' governs; on a very slow runner a slow acknowledgement turns the law red instead of only slower.
